photos.caption: Rainy Car Rides
photos.description: Rain covers the windshield and breaks the road ahead into soft amber and red shapes. The wiper edge cuts across the glass while blurred traffic and wet pavement make the car’s slow, enclosed nighttime ride feel private and cinematic.
